title: Bawah Jejambat
subject: twenty motorcyclists waiting out the rain under a flyover
caption: Malaysian dikir barat adapted to pop. Rebana frame drums driving an interlocking pattern, maracas shaking on the offbeats, heavy group handclaps and thigh-slap body percussion, one low gong marking the section changes, and almost no harmonic instruments at all. Dry and percussive with the voices stacked very wide and the drums close. A single male lead caller delivering each line and a large seated group answering him in unison, call and response throughout, shouted rather than polished. 112 BPM, D minor pentatonic. Strangers made equal by weather. No guitars, no keyboard, no synth, no drum kit, no key change.
lyrics:
[Intro - rebana and group handclaps]

[Verse 1 - Lead Caller]
Hujan turun pukul lima, semua berhenti serentak
Dua puluh motosikal bawah jejambat, tak kenal sesiapa
Bahu dengan bahu, enjin panas, bau asap
Tiada siapa bercakap, tapi kami semua satu pasukan

[Chorus - Group Response]
Bawah jejambat, kami tunggu
Bukan kawan, bukan saudara, tapi kami tunggu sama
Hujan tak tanya kau kerja apa
Hujan tak tanya kau nak ke mana

[Verse 2 - Lead Caller]
Ada abang bagi plastik pada budak depan dia
Budak tu cakap terima kasih, abang tu angguk, habis cerita
Ada makcik jual pisang goreng, hari ini dia untung
Hujan ni rezeki dia, dan dia tak sembunyikan senyum tu

[Chorus - Group Response]
Bawah jejambat, kami tunggu
Bukan kawan, bukan saudara, tapi kami tunggu sama
Hujan tak tanya kau kerja apa
Hujan tak kisah kau nak ke mana

[Bridge - handclaps and voices only]
Hujan reda. Semua hidupkan enjin serentak.
Macam ada orang bagi isyarat. Tak ada orang bagi isyarat.

[Outro - rebana slowing]
Esok hujan lagi
Jumpa lagi, orang yang aku tak kenal
